description: 404 Reika Not Found is a Bandung-based team exploring NASA’s Dancing with the SARs challenge. Our city is slowly sinking, and radar from orbit can measure it. We’re using NISAR data to turn invisible ground motion into maps people can act on. We’re learning SAR as we build, so we value curiosity and honest science over hype. Looking for teammates in remote sensing/GIS, Python, data viz, or Earth science. Join us if you like hard problems and good questions.
